import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
import numpy as np
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i=np.array(G[n+' input']); o=np.array(G[n+' output'])
    seeds={(r,c) for r in range(i.shape[0]) for c in range(i.shape[1]) if i[r,c] not in (0,) and not False} 
    # find minority color
    vals,cnt=np.unique(i,return_counts=True)
    bg=vals[cnt.argmax()]
    rare=[v for v,c in zip(vals,cnt) if c==min(cnt)]
    print(n,'bg',bg,'rare',rare)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(i.shape[0]) for c in range(i.shape[1]) if i[r,c] in rare]
    print(' seeds:',sorted(pts))
    thr=[(r,c) for r in range(o.shape[0]) for c in range(o.shape[1]) if o[r,c]==3]
    print(' 3s :',sorted(thr))
print('TEST minority colors:',[(v,c) for v,c in zip(*np.unique(np.array(G['Test input']),return_counts=True))] )

import numpy as np, json
def f(g):
    g=np.array(g)
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True)
    bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()])
    rare=[int(v) for v,c in zip(vals,cnt) if c==min(cnt)]
    pts=sorted((r,c) for r in range(g.shape[0]) for c in range(g.shape[1]) if g[r,c] in rare)
    obrows=[r for r in range(g.shape[0]) if np.all(g[r,:]==bg)]
    band_row=obrows[0]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[0],pts[-1]
    dr=r2-r1; dc=c2-c1
    t=(band_row-1-r1)/dr
    ax=round(c1+t*dc)
    out=g.copy()
    def free(r,c): return 0<=r<g.shape[0] and 0<=c<g.shape[1] and g[r,c]==bg
    # reflected ray starting from each seed point, direction (+1,+1) after column flip
    for r,c in pts:
        c2=2*ax-c
        rr=r+1; cc=c2+1
        while free(rr,cc):
            out[rr,cc]=3
            rr+=1; cc+=1
    return out.tolist()
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(n,'match:',f(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def diag_info(n):
    g=G[n+' input']; o=G[n+' output']
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    rare=[c for c,v in [(k,sum(v==k for r in g for x in r)) for k,r in enumerate([])] if False]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==min((v for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=bg)) and cnt[g[r][c]]<cnt[bg]]
    # better: minority color = least frequent overall
    mc=min(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==mc]
    n3=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if o[r][c]==3 and g[r][c]!=3]
    return bg,mc,g,h,w,seeds,n3,cnt
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    d=diag_info(n); print('=====',n,'bg',d[0],'min',d[1],'h,w',d[3],d[4],'seeds',d[5],'new3s',d[6],'allcnt',sorted(d[7].items()))

def sign(x): return (x>0)-(x<0)
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    order=cnt.most_common()
    bg=order[0][0]; bar=order[1][0]
    rare=min((k for k,_ in order), key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==rare]
    d=(sign(seeds[1][0]-seeds[0][0]), sign(seeds[1][1]-seeds[0][1]))
    def walk(s,d2):
        path=[]; r,c=s
        while True:
            nxt=(r+d2[0],c+d2[1])
            if not(0<=nxt[0]<h and 0<=nxt[1]<w) or g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bar: break
            r,c=nxt; path.append((r,c))
        return path,g[r][c]
    # two rays from chain ends along its line; prefer ray that reaches barrier (ends at non-bg cell)
    res=[(walk(seeds[0],(-d[0],-d[1])), g[seeds[0][0]+(-d[0])*0,0], seeds[0]) for _ in [0]]
    r1,v1,s1=walk(seeds[0],(-d[0],-d[1]))
    r2,v2,s2=walk(seeds[-1],d)
    cand=[(q,v,s) for q,v,s in [(r1,v1,s1),(r2,v2,s2)] if len(q)>0 or v!=bg]
    if not cand: return g
    anchor=cand[0][0][-1]
    # pick candidate whose walk actually terminates at a non-bg cell
    chosen=max(cand,key=lambda t:(t[1]!=bg,len(t[0])))
    anchor=chosen[0][-1]
    newg=[row[:] for row in g]
    for ddr in [(d[1],-d[0]),(-d[1],d[0])]:
        r,c=anchor
        while True:
            r,c=(r+ddr[0],c+ddr[1])
            if not(0<=r<h and 0<=c<w) or g[r][c]==bar: break
            newg[r][c]=3
    return newg
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(n,'match',f(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])
ti=G['Test input']; o=f(ti)
print('test out:')
for r,row in enumerate(o): print(r,row)

from collections import Counter
def sign(x): return (x>0)-(x<0)
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); keys=[k for k,_ in cnt.most_common()]
    bg,bp,rare=keys[0],keys[1],keys[-1]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==rare]
    d=(sign(seeds[1][0]-seeds[0][0]),sign(seeds[1][1]-seeds[0][1]))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def paint(r,c,dr,dc):
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==bg:
            out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    # anchor = seed closest to band along the line direction (d), painted as 3 only if background (not seed)
    # extend line until next cell is bp or edge; anchor = last non-bg non-seed? Actually anchor is the cell adjacent to band on the line.
    best=None
    for dr,dc in [(d[0],d[1]),(-d[0],-d[1])]:
        for s in [seeds[0],seeds[-1]]:
            p=[]; r,c=s
            while True:
                nxt=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if not(0<=nxt[0]<h and 0<=nxt[1]<w) or g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bp: break
                p.append(nxt); r,c=nxt
            if p:
                cand=(-len(p),tuple(p))
                if best is None or cand>best: best=cand
    _,path=best
    anchor=path[-1]
    out[anchor[0]][anchor[1]]=3
    rot=(-d[1],d[0])
    for dr,dc in [(rot[0],rot[1]),(-rot[0],-rot[1])]:
        paint(anchor[0],anchor[1],dr,dc)
    return out
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print('===',n,'match',f(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])

from collections import Counter
def sign(x): return (x>0)-(x<0)
def rays(g, seeds, d):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); keys=[k for k,_ in cnt.most_common()]
    bg,bp,rare=keys[0],keys[1],keys[-1]
    cand=[]
    ends=[seeds[0],seeds[-1]]
    for s in ends:
        for dr,dc in [(d[0],d[1]),(-d[0],-d[1])]:
            r,c=s; p=[]
            while True:
                nxt=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if not(0<=nxt[0]<h and 0<=nxt[1]<w) or g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bp: break
                p.append(nxt); r,c=nxt
            cand.append((len(p), tuple(p), s, (dr,dc)))
    return cand
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    i=G[n+' input']
    h,w=len(i),len(i[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in i for x in r); keys=[k for k,_ in cnt.most_common()]
    bg,bp,rare=keys[0],keys[1],keys[-1]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c]==rare]
    d=(sign(seeds[1][0]-seeds[0][0]),sign(seeds[1][1]-seeds[0][1]))
    print('===',n,'rays:',rays(i,seeds,d))
    print('expected 3s:',[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if G[n+' output'][r][c]==3])

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); keys=[k for k,_ in cnt.most_common()]
    bg,bp,rare=keys[0],keys[1],keys[-1]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==rare]
    d=(sign(seeds[1][0]-seeds[0][0]),sign(seeds[1][1]-seeds[0][1]))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # candidate cells whose step along +d reaches band/edge within 1..k steps, choose one adjacent to band
    def dist(r,c):
        rr,cc=r+d[0],c+d[1]
        k=1
        while True:
            rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]; k+=1
            if not(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w) or g[rr][cc]==bp: return k
        return k
    anchor=min(seeds,key=lambda s:dist(*s))
    # walk from anchor backwards along -d to find where band stops us, then anchor is the last cell before band
    r,c=anchor
    while True:
        nxt=(r-d[0],c-d[1])
        if not(0<=nxt[0]<h and 0<=nxt[1]<w) or g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bp: break
        r,c=nxt
    anchor=(r,c)
    rot=(-d[1],d[0])
    def paint(r,c,dr,dc):
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==bg:
            out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    if g[anchor[0]][anchor[1]]==bg: out[anchor[0]][anchor[1]]=3
    for dr,dc in [(rot[0],rot[1]),(-rot[0],-rot[1])]:
        paint(anchor[0],anchor[1],dr,dc)
    return out
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:

from collections import Counter
import json
def sign(x): return (x>0)-(x<0)

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg,bp,rare = cnt.most_common()[-1] if False else None
    # most_common returns (value,count); rare color = smallest count
    order=[(c,v) for v,c in cnt.most_common()]
    rank=list(order)
    bgv,bpc,rv=c[0] if False else 0,0,0
    ranks=[c for _,c in cnt.most_common()]
    bg=rank[0]; bp=rank[1]; rare=rank[-1]
    # band cells = bp; seeds = rare
    band=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==bp]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==rare]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    d=(sign(seeds[1][0]-seeds[0][0]), sign(seeds[1][1]-seeds[0][1]))
    # ray from each seed along +d and -d until hitting band or edge; collect path cells that are bg
    def walk(s,dr,dc):
        rr,cc=r0:=s[0]+dr, s[1]+dc
        k=[]
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]!=bp:
            if g[rr][cc]==bg: k.append((rr,cc))
            rr+=dr; cc+=dc
        return k
    # anchor candidate: for the whole seed line extended in its direction, the cell just before the band
    # find which seed has a neighbor along +d that is band
    def dist_to_band_cell(s):
        dr=sign(s[1][0]-s[0][0]); dc=sign(s[1][1]-s[0][1])
        r,c=s[0],s[1]
        step=0
        while True:
            r+=dr;c+=dc;step+=1
            if not(0<=r<h and 0<=c<w) or g[r][c]==bp: break
        return step
    anchor=None
    best=min([(dist_to_band_cell(s), s) for s in seeds])
    ar,best_s=best
    r,c=best_s; k=ar-1
    for _ in range(k):
        r+=d[0]; c+=d[1]
    anchor=(r,c)
    rot=(-d[1],d[0])
    def paint(r0,dr,dc):
        rr,cc=r0+dr,c0+dc
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==bg:
            out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    if g[anchor[0]][anchor[1]]==bg:
        out[anchor[0]][anchor[1]]=3
    for dr,dc in [(rot[0],rot[1]),(-rot[0],-rot[1])]:
        paint(anchor[0],anchor[1],dr,dc)
    return out
